name: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp.
description: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp. is a Reno-based royalty and streaming company focused on precious metals assets primarily in Nevada and Idaho. The company operates a three-part business model combining mineral royalty creation and acquisition, precious-metals streaming, and an exploration project accelerator. It holds mineral properties in Mineral County and Elko County, Nevada, and in Boise County, Idaho, and trades on the OTCQX Best Market.
